def _run_episode(dsn: str, world: int, seq: int, task: str) -> tuple:
    from experiments.ad01 import trajectory
    cid = trajectory.campaign_id(world, "I", seq)
    _authorize(dsn, cid)
    campaign = trajectory.run_campaign(
        world, "I", dict(CHARTER), dict(CAPS), tasks=[task],
        campaign_seq=seq, dsn=dsn, study_root=STUDY_ROOT)
    record = {"campaign_id": cid, "task_id": task,
            "policy_steps": len(campaign["boundaries"]),
            "model_calls": int(campaign["model_calls"]),
            "witness_queries": int(campaign["queries"]),
            "construction_calls": int(
                campaign["construction_calls"]),
            "dispositions": [e.get("disposition") for e in
                             campaign["episodes"]],
            "operations": _campaign_ops(dsn, cid)}
    return record, campaign
def _construct_arm(dsn: str, arm: str, task_id: str, scripts: list,
                   experience: dict, seq: int) -> dict:
    from experiments.ad01 import construct, trajectory, worlds
    cid = trajectory.campaign_id(0, "I", seq)
    _authorize(dsn, cid)
    trajectory.ensure_campaign(
        dsn, cid, 0, "I", dict(CHARTER), dict(CAPS), tasks=[task_id],
        study_root=STUDY_ROOT)
    task = worlds.load_task(worlds.FROZEN_DIR, task_id)
    ops_before = set(_campaign_ops(dsn, cid))
    try:
        member = construct.construct_method(
            dsn, campaign_id=cid, task=task,
            experience={**experience, "boundary": {"seq": 0}},
            budget={"max_output_tokens": 512, "max_queries": 4,
                    "model_calls": 2},
            gateway=_recording_gateway(scripts),
            model="recorded-double", study_root=STUDY_ROOT)
    except construct.ConstructionFailed as exc:
        ops = sorted(set(_campaign_ops(dsn, cid)) - ops_before)
        return {"arm": arm, "status": "unavailable",
                "reason": "construction exhausted within 1-init-plus"
                          "-1-repair allowance: %s" % exc,
                "calls": int(exc.calls_made), "operations": ops,
                "init_operation": (ops[0] if ops else None),
                "repair_operation": (ops[1] if len(ops) > 1 else None)}
    ops = sorted(set(_campaign_ops(dsn, cid)) - ops_before)
    lineage = member.get("lineage", {})
    return {"arm": arm, "status": "available",
            "capability_id": member["capability_id"],
            "method_source": member["method_source"],
            "entry": member["entry"],
            "source_digest": member["source_digest"],
            "scope": member["scope"],
            "calls": int(lineage.get("calls_made", 0)),
            "operations": ops,
            "init_operation": lineage.get("init_operation"),
            "repair_operation": lineage.get("repair_operation")}
def run_study(dsn: str, out_dir, *,
              gateway_mode: str = "doubles") -> dict:
    if gateway_mode == "live":
        import os
        if not os.environ.get("S09_M5_LIVE_GRANT"):
            raise ValueError(
                "live runs only on a fresh human grant with one exact"
                " command and cap sheet, never the spent grant:"
                " set S09_M5_LIVE_GRANT to the granted study identity")
    from experiments.ad01 import trajectory
    from scripts import s09_verify as _verify
    out = Path(out_dir)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    freeze = build_freeze()
    (out / "freeze.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(freeze, sort_keys=True, indent=1) + "\n")
    _authorize_root(dsn)

    development = []
    dev_campaigns = []
    for index, spec in enumerate(DEV_SPECS):
        record, campaign = _run_episode(dsn, spec["world"], 50 + index,
                                        spec["task_id"])
        development.append({**spec, **record})
        dev_campaigns.append(campaign)

    dev_observations = []
    for record in development:
        dev_observations.extend(
            _dev_observations(dsn, record["campaign_id"]))

    construction = {}
    p1 = _construct_arm(
        dsn, "P1", P1_TASK,
        [_script(json.dumps({"entry": DOUBLED_SOURCE,
                             "notes": "doubled candidate"}))],
        {"observations": []}, 54)
    construction["P1"] = p1
    p2 = _construct_arm(
        dsn, "P2", P2_TASK,
        [_script("not-json{{{"),
         _script(json.dumps({"entry": BROKEN_SOURCE,
                             "notes": "doubled broken repair"}))],
        {"observations": dev_observations}, 55)
    construction["P2"] = p2

    members = {}
    if p1["status"] == "available":
        members["P1"] = {key: p1[key] for key in
                         ("capability_id", "method_source", "entry",
                          "source_digest", "scope")}
    frozen_digest = freeze["freeze_digest"]

    assessment = []
    use_records = []
    for index, spec in enumerate(_assess_specs()):
        record, _campaign = _run_episode(dsn, spec["world"], 60 + index,
                                         spec["investigation_task"])
        entry = {**spec, **record, "freeze_digest": frozen_digest}
        assessment.append(entry)
        repertoire = {"campaign_id": record["campaign_id"],
                      "queries": 0, "members": []}
        if spec["arm"] in members:
            repertoire["members"] = [dict(members[spec["arm"]],
                                          authored=False,
                                          params={"max_queries": 4})]
        use_cid = trajectory.campaign_id(spec["world"], "I",
                                         90 + index)
        allocation = _authorize(dsn, use_cid)
        trajectory.ensure_campaign(
            dsn, use_cid, spec["world"], "I", dict(CHARTER),
            dict(CAPS), tasks=list(spec["use_tasks"]),
            study_root=STUDY_ROOT)
        records = trajectory.run_use(
            repertoire, spec["world"], "I", list(spec["use_tasks"]),
            {}, dsn=dsn, allocation_id=allocation)
        for task_id, saved in zip(spec["use_tasks"], records):
            saved["record_id"] = "%s-%s" % (spec["episode_id"],
                                            task_id)
            saved["episode_id"] = spec["episode_id"]
            saved["study_arm"] = spec["arm"]
            if spec["arm"] == "P2":
                reason = construction["P2"].get("reason", "")
                saved["fallback_reason"] = \
                    "arm-unavailable: %s; %s" % (
                        reason, saved.get("fallback_reason", ""))
            use_records.append(saved)

    probes = _refusal_probes(dsn)

    claimed: set = set()
    for episode in development + assessment:
        claimed.update(episode.get("operations", []))
    for arm_entry in construction.values():
        claimed.update(arm_entry.get("operations", []))
    for saved in use_records:
        claimed.update(saved.get("operation_ids", []))
    operations = _embed_operations(dsn, claimed)

    rejected = sum(
        1 for episode in development + assessment
        for disposition in episode.get("dispositions", [])
        if disposition in ("rejected", "no-candidate"))
    executed = sum(episode.get("policy_steps", 0)
                   for episode in development + assessment)
    model_total = sum(episode.get("model_calls", 0)
                      for episode in development + assessment) + sum(
        arm_entry.get("calls", 0)
        for arm_entry in construction.values())
    repairs = sum(1 for arm_entry in construction.values()
                  for op in arm_entry.get("operations", [])
                  if "-repair" in op)
    accounting = {
        "construction": {
            "measured": sum(arm_entry.get("calls", 0)
                            for arm_entry in construction.values()),
            "source": "durable-model-inference-operations"},
        "rejected_actions": {
            "measured": rejected,
            "source": "episode-dispositions"},
        "policy_execution": {
            "measured": executed,
            "source": "settled-boundaries"},
        "model_requests": {
            "measured": model_total,
            "source": "episode-plus-construction-census"},
        "use": {
            "measured": len(use_records),
            "source": "sealed-use-records"},
        "repair": {
            "measured": repairs,
            "source": "repair-attempt-operations"},
        "charge_units": {
            "measured": "unknown",
            "source": "doubles-carry-no-priced-charge"},
    }

    bundle = {"freeze": freeze, "development": development,
              "construction": construction, "assessment": assessment,
              "use_records": use_records, "operations": operations,
              "accounting": accounting, "refusal_probes": probes,
              "conformance_replay": _conformance_replay(
                  dsn, dev_campaigns[0])}
    for name in ("development", "construction", "assessment",
                 "use_records", "operations", "accounting",
                 "refusal_probes", "conformance_replay"):
        (out / ("%s.json" % name)).write_text(
            json.dumps(bundle[name], sort_keys=True, indent=1,
                       default=str) + "\n")
    verdict = _verify.verify_bundle(bundle)
    (out / "verify.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(verdict, sort_keys=True, indent=1) + "\n")
    if verdict["status"] != "pass":
        raise ValueError("pilot bundle fails verification: %s"
                         % verdict["problems"])
    return bundle

def bind_revision(dsn: str, *, release_id: str, versions: list,
                  scope: dict, disposition: str, fallback: str = "",
                  expected_versions: list | None,
                  policy_version: str = "",
                  protocol_id: str = "",
                  evaluator_version: str = "",
                  request_id: str | None = None) -> dict:
    from psycopg.types.json import Json
    from settlement import store
    from settlement.common import Command, ResultCode
    if not release_id or not versions:
        raise ValueError("bind needs a release id and exact versions")
    if disposition not in ("candidate", "experimental", "limited",
                           "default", "quarantined", "retired"):
        raise ValueError("unknown disposition %r" % (disposition,))
    if request_id is None:
        from settlement.common import payload_digest
        digest = payload_digest({"release": release_id,
                                 "versions": list(versions)})[:12]
        request_id = "s09-bind-%s-%s" % (release_id, digest)

    def _fn(cur, control):
        cur.execute("SELECT * FROM capability_releases WHERE id = %s"
                    " FOR UPDATE", (release_id,))
        current = cur.fetchone()
        if current is None:
            if expected_versions not in (None, []):
                raise StaleBind(
                    "no binding for %r, expected %r" % (
                        release_id, expected_versions))
            cur.execute(
                "INSERT INTO capability_releases"
                " (id, protocol_id, versions, scope, disposition,"
                " fallback, policy_version, invalidation,"
                " evidence_refs, evaluator_version)"
                " VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)",
                (release_id, protocol_id, Json(list(versions)),
                 Json(dict(scope)), disposition, fallback,
                 policy_version, Json({}), Json([]),
                 evaluator_version))
            return (ResultCode.APPLIED, "bound %s" % release_id,
                    {"release_id": release_id,
                     "versions": list(versions)}, [], [])
        have = list(dict(current).get("versions") or [])
        if expected_versions != have:
            raise StaleBind(
                "stale bind for %r: expected %r, have %r" % (
                    release_id, expected_versions, have))
        cur.execute(
            "UPDATE capability_releases SET protocol_id = %s,"
            " versions = %s, scope = %s, disposition = %s,"
            " fallback = %s, policy_version = %s,"
            " evaluator_version = %s"
            " WHERE id = %s",
            (protocol_id, Json(list(versions)), Json(dict(scope)),
             disposition, fallback, policy_version,
             evaluator_version, release_id))
        return (ResultCode.APPLIED, "rebound %s" % release_id,
                {"release_id": release_id,
                 "versions": list(versions)}, [], [])

    result = store.transact(dsn, Command(request_id=request_id,
                                         payload={"release_id": release_id,
                                                  "versions": list(versions),
                                                  "scope": dict(scope),
                                                  "disposition": disposition}),
                            _fn)
    if result.code not in (ResultCode.APPLIED,
                           ResultCode.ALREADY_APPLIED):
        raise StaleBind(result.detail or "bind refused")
    with _read_conn(dsn) as conn:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM capability_releases WHERE id = %s",
            (release_id,)).fetchone()
        conn.commit()
        return dict(row) if row is not None else {}

def decide(self, seen: dict, asked: dict, *, boundary,
               experience: dict, aid: str | None = None) -> dict:
        from . import policy_step
        from . import trajectory as _trajectory
        from . import worlds as _worlds
        if self._disconnected is not None:
            return self._refuse(
                "decision consumer disconnected: %s"
                % self._disconnected, 0)
        seq = (boundary or {}).get("seq", 0)
        self._seq = int(seq) if isinstance(seq, int) else 0
        observations = list((seen or {}).get("observations") or [])
        if not observations:
            return self._refuse("policy step needs a seed observation",
                                0)
        task_id = observations[-1].get("task_id")
        try:
            task = _worlds.load_task(_worlds.FROZEN_DIR, task_id)
        except (KeyError, TypeError):
            return self._refuse("unknown policy task %r" % (task_id,),
                                0)
        eligible = sorted({m.get("capability_id")
                           for m in (seen or {}).get("retained") or []
                           if isinstance(m, dict)
                           and m.get("capability_id")})
        open_questions: list = []
        last_result = None
        state: dict = {}
        views: list = []
        results: list = []
        transitions: list = []
        remaining = _step_remaining(seen, self._max_policy_steps)
        for index in range(self._max_policy_steps):
            view = policy_step.materialize_view(
                task=task, observations=observations,
                open_questions=open_questions, last_result=last_result,
                eligible_methods=eligible, remaining=remaining)
            operation_id = "ad01-%s-policy-s%d-k%d" % (
                self._cid, self._seq, index)
            try:
                stepped = policy_step.run_policy_step(
                    {"artifact": self._policy,
                     "policy_source": self._policy_source},
                    view, state, timeout_ms=self._timeout_ms,
                    cpu_seconds=self._cpu_seconds,
                    max_output_bytes=self._max_output_bytes,
                    dsn=self._dsn,
                    allocation_id=self._allocation_id
                    or _trajectory._alloc_id(self._cid),
                    operation_id=operation_id
                    if self._dsn is not None else None)
            except Exception as exc:
                return self._refuse("policy step failed: %s" % exc,
                                    index)
            action = stepped["action"]
            previous = dict(state)
            state = dict(stepped["state"])
            views.append(view)
            results.append({"action": action, "state": state})
            transitions.append({"previous": previous, "next": state})
            remaining = _step_remaining(seen, self._max_policy_steps
                                        - index - 1)
            kind = action["kind"]
            if kind == "request_model":
                response, failure = self._model_request(
                    action, remaining, index)
                if failure is not None:
                    last_result = failure
                    open_questions.append(failure["reason"])
                    continue
                remaining["model_calls"] = int(
                    remaining.get("model_calls", 0)) - 1
                last_result = {"kind": "model_response",
                               "digest": response["digest"],
                               "text": response["text"],
                               "truncated": response["truncated"]}
                continue
            if kind in _STEP_TO_LEGACY:
                proposal = _step_proposal(
                    action, seen, asked, boundary,
                    _step_family(action.get("target")))
                admitted = _trajectory.admit_investigation(
                    proposal, seen, asked, boundary)
                if admitted.get("decision") != "admitted":
                    last_result = {"status": "refused",
                                   "reason": admitted.get(
                                       "reason", "refused")}
                    open_questions.append(last_result["reason"])
                    continue
                investigation = admitted["investigation"]
                policy_step.persist_step_transition(
                    self._dsn, self._cid, self._seq, views=views,
                    results=results, transitions=transitions,
                    investigation=investigation,
                    source_digest=stepped["source_digest"])
                self.decided.append(
                    (investigation.get("next_action") or {}).get(
                        "task_id"))
                return {"status": "admitted",
                        "investigation": investigation,
                        "corrections": index}
            if kind == "propose_revision":
                inputs = dict(action.get("inputs") or {})
                investigation = {
                    "basis_references": [
                        r for r in action.get("evidence_refs") or []
                        if isinstance(r, str)],
                    "question": inputs.get("question")
                    or "policy proposed revision",
                    "revision_proposal": {
                        "scope": inputs.get("scope", {}),
                        "parent_digest":
                        self._policy["source_digest"],
                        "motivation": inputs.get("motivation", ""),
                    },
                    "next_action": {
                        "kind": "stop",
                        "reason": inputs.get(
                            "reason", "policy proposed revision")},
                }
                policy_step.persist_step_transition(
                    self._dsn, self._cid, self._seq, views=views,
                    results=results, transitions=transitions,
                    investigation=investigation,
                    source_digest=stepped["source_digest"])
                return {"status": "admitted",
                        "investigation": investigation,
                        "corrections": index}
            investigation = {
                "basis_references": [],
                "question": dict(action.get("inputs") or {}).get(
                    "reason", "policy stop"),
                "next_action": {"kind": "stop",
                                "reason": dict(
                                    action.get("inputs") or {}).get(
                                    "reason", "policy stop")},
            }
            policy_step.persist_step_transition(
                self._dsn, self._cid, self._seq, views=views,
                results=results, transitions=transitions,
                investigation=investigation,
                source_digest=stepped["source_digest"])
            return {"status": "admitted",
                    "investigation": investigation,
                    "corrections": index}
        return self._refuse("policy step budget exhausted (%d steps)"
                            % self._max_policy_steps,
                            self._max_policy_steps)
